company.name: 健立生醫股份有限公司

description.text:
▎Own end-to-end feature delivery for the healthcare ERP product line, from requirements clarification through implementation, deployment, and monitoring.
▎Build and extend Odoo modules covering pharmaceutical and medical-supply inventory, lot and expiry tracking, procurement, and clinical supply chain.
▎Design and build operational reports and dashboards for inventory turnover, expiry alerting, reconciliation, and departmental performance.
▎Build data models and serving layers that feed BI tooling across all five product lines.
▎Integrate the ERP with HIS, PACS, and CRM systems through APIs and message-based interfaces.
▎Build administrative and back-office web interfaces used by pharmacy, supply chain, and finance staff.
▎Collaborate with platform engineers to define API contracts and own end-user-perceived performance.
【BASIC QUALIFICATIONS】
▎3+ years of professional software development experience building and shipping business or enterprise applications.
▎Strong proficiency in Python, including at least one production web framework (Django, FastAPI, or Odoo's own framework).
▎Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern frontend framework (React, Vue.js, or equivalent).
▎Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL), including data modeling for business domain objects, complex queries, and performance tuning.
▎Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, and building integrations against third-party systems.
▎Experience building reports or dashboards from operational data, including aggregation logic and parameterized output.
▎Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerized deployment.
▎Proficiency with Git-based workflows and experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment.
▎Professional reading proficiency in English, sufficient to work directly from framework documentation, API references, and open-source codebases.
▎Native or near-native Traditional Chinese for user-facing copy, UI text, and business documentation.
▎Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
